definitions.explanation: A fish that lives in the deep ocean, generally below about 200 meters, often with odd shapes or light-producing organs.

examples.japanese: {深海魚|しんかいぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{深海魚|しんかいぎょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rare deep-sea fish are on display at the aquarium.

examples.japanese: {深海魚|しんかいぎょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浜|はま}→浜：05041_hama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられる→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前触|まえぶ}れ→前触れ：06632_maebure⟧だ、⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言|い}い{伝|つた}え→言い伝え：14145_iitsutae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a folk belief that deep-sea fish washing up on the beach foretell an earthquake.

notes:
Some deep-water fish are popular food in Japan, such as {金目鯛|きんめだい} (splendid alfonsino). The earthquake folklore centers on the oarfish (リュウグウノツカイ); scientists have found no reliable link.
